GENE-001.name: Leaderboard Membership Check
GENE-001.rule: Before ANY trade approval, verify strategy exists in strategy_leaderboard.json. If missing → BLOCK trade.

GENE-002.name: Leaderboard Status Gate
GENE-002.rule: Strategy status must be 'active' for full-size trades. 'testing' → experimental size only (max $100). 'rejected' or missing → BLOCK.

GENE-003.name: Deploy Before Declare
GENE-003.rule: Code is not 'fixed' until the process is running and health check passes. Manual test ≠ deployed.

GENE-004.name: Delivery Confirmation Required
GENE-004.rule: Generated report ≠ delivered report. Delivery must be confirmed via external channel or CEO acknowledgment.

GENE-005.name: External Channel Fallback
GENE-005.rule: If chat delivery fails, report must be available via dashboard file, email, or Telegram within 5 minutes.

GENE-006.name: Broker Truth Override
GENE-006.rule: Alpaca API is the source of truth for positions. Local state must be rebuilt from broker data every cycle. Mismatch → alert + auto-correct.

GENE-007.name: Exit Idempotency
GENE-007.rule: Each exit action (partial sell, full sell, runner) can execute exactly once per position stage. Repeated triggers must be blocked.

GENE-008.name: Dust Quantity Block
GENE-008.rule: No sell order for quantity < 0.00001. Dust positions must be ignored, not sold.

GENE-009.name: Pre-Cycle Self-Check
GENE-009.rule: Every trading cycle must start with self-check: watchdog running? strategies validated? state reconciled? If any fail → cycle blocked.

GENE-010.name: Memory Lesson Enforcement
GENE-010.rule: Every memory lesson must have a corresponding runtime check, test, or pipeline block. Notes without enforcement are incomplete.
